messages:
ben: Heads up - PR #5102 (migration guide link fixes + small example tweak) is ready for review but our primary reviewer (sam) is on PTO this week. Linkcheck failing on one internal reference.

marie: I saw that. The failing link is to the old `redwood-internal/ops/runbook.md`. The repo moved -> new path is `ops/runbooks/serving.md`. Quick patch will fix it.

ben: Yep that's the one. The linkcheck job shows: `ERROR: 1 broken link (redwood-internal/ops/runbook.md -> 404)`. CI otherwise green.

tara: I can pick this up. Quick question: are we comfortable approving & merging docs-only changes without a full content SME review? Historically we do if it's small lint/link/snippet fixes.

lee: We (docs team) have a 2-step rule: docs-only + CI green + linkcheck green -> auto-merge during doc-merge window. If there are API example changes, need an SDK reviewer. This PR has a tiny SDK example tweak (rename param) — so it needs at least a quick SDK eyes signoff.

ben: The SDK tweak is just renaming `force_refresh=True` to `refresh=True` in the snippet (we standardized params last month). Not a behavior change.

marie: Given that, propose: tara fixes link, lee does a quick SDK pass (5m) and approves, then docs-ci-bot will allow merge in the next doc-merge slot (no late-night). Anyone object?

lee: Sounds good. I'm around in the 1pm-3pm PT slot and can do the SDK check.

ben: One wrinkle: our reviewer rotation shows a coverage gap for SDK snippets this week because two reviewers are on rotation overlap. We should probably add a 'temp-subscriber' list for small snippet approvals.

tara: I can open an RFC after this to add a lightweight reviewer pool (docs-snippet-approvers) with a single-click assigner. For now, manual is fine.

marie: I've prepared the exact link patch. Pasting diff here:
```diff
- [Runbook](redwood-internal/ops/runbook.md)
+ [Runbook](ops/runbooks/serving.md)
```

ben: Nice. @lee once you finish SDK quick check, can you add `approved-by: lee` in the PR comment so docs-ci-bot knows it's ok to merge?

docs-ci-bot: Noted. When PR has label `docs/ready` and a comment `approved-by: <reviewer>`, I'll queue it for the next merge window. Current queue: empty.

lee: SDK snippet looks good. Param rename is correct, tests pass locally with snippet example. Left a one-line comment about phrasing. Adding `approved-by: lee` now.

ben: Tagged `docs/ready`. Triggering linkcheck rerun now.

docs-ci-bot: Linkcheck passed. Preview build started (preview-5102-1).

tara: Preview looks healthy in us-west. kicking eu runner too for parity.

marie: Thanks all. After merge, I'll open the RFC for the docs-snippet-approvers pool so we don't hit this kind of gap next time.

ben: Final: tara will merge during the docs merge window at 4pm PT, lee did SDK approval, docs-ci-bot will merge once the scheduled window opens. Thanks :white_check_mark:
